name: signal
title: Add Signal
description: Creates a signal folder's settings, contract and README from its template.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Name
settings.description: Signal name. ID is allocated automatically.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Folder Path
settings.description: Final output folder: relative to the selected world root, or absolute without a selection. The name is not appended.

settings.name: type
settings.title: Type
settings.description: What the item is, such as component, atom or function. Unclassified when empty.

settings.name: transmitting
settings.title: Transmitting
settings.description: Whether the signal participates in discovery. Preserves an explicit false.
